svg.title: A UDP datagram of two ASTERIX data blocks
svg.desc: The 66-byte UDP payload of frame 3 of cat_034_048.pcap: a CAT 048 data block of 55 bytes, one byte of category, two of length, a three-octet FSPEC and 15 items, then a CAT 034 block of 11 bytes with a one-octet FSPEC and 4 items. The two lengths add up to the payload exactly, so AsterixPacket has two blocks and the flow is labelled ASTERIX. A block of category 62, a length one byte too long, or one trailing byte each fail the whole datagram.
